messages:
ryan: deploy-bot flagged a p95 spike on /generate in us-central after 2.8.2. looks like tail latency only.
deploy-bot: deploybot:signal: region=us-central route=/generate p95 > threshold for 4m. recommendation: STAGED_PIN to previous kernel flag. auto_revert: OFF.
marta: can we do a 5% pin first and run smoke? we have a marketing load this afternoon.
ops-oncall: agree. plan: 5% -> 25% -> 100%, 5m soak each stage. I'll execute and notify support.
ryan: logs show kernel=fastpath is in use, p95 ~ 480ms. snippet: `2026-03-24T14:02:11Z p95=482ms kernel=fastpath`. errors flat.
ops-oncall: kicking off 5%: `infractl pin --region us-central --route /generate --version 2.8.1 --slice 5 --reason "p95 tail"`
deploy-bot: deploybot:action: pin_job started id=pin-1785554321-1
marta: running quick smoke set "gen_smoke_v1" now. will alert partner success if anything odd.
ops-oncall: 5% stable after 6m. p95 down ~45%. proceeding to 25%.
deploy-bot: deploybot:action: pin_job started id=pin-1785554321-2
marta: smoke eval green. no impact on partner jobs.
ops-oncall: moving to 100% now. `infractl pin --region us-central --route /generate --version 2.8.1 --slice 100`
deploy-bot: deploybot:action: pin_job started id=pin-1785554321-3
ryan: posting short status: "Staged rollback to 2.8.1 completed in us-central for /generate due to p95 tail. Monitoring."
tori: creating ticket INF-2026-470 for postmortem and release note amendment.
ops-oncall: pin applied; marking thread resolved once ticket created.
deploy-bot: deploybot:signal: pin_job completed id=pin-1785554321-3 status=success
